title: Small cochain dg categories
statement: A small cochain dg category over a commutative ring $R$ (over $\mathbf Z$ when $R=\mathbf Z$) consists of a set of objects, for each pair of objects $x,y$ a cochain complex of $R$-modules $\mathcal A(x,y)$, a closed degree-zero identity $1_x\in\mathcal A(x,x)^0$, and $R$-bilinear right-to-left compositions $\mathcal A(y,z)^p\times\mathcal A(x,y)^q\to\mathcal A(x,z)^{p+q}$ that are associative and unital and satisfy the graded Leibniz rule $d(ba)=d(b)a+(-1)^{p}b\,d(a)$ for $b$ of degree $p$; equivalently, a category enriched over cochain complexes of $R$-modules with the Koszul-signed tensor product [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. A dg functor is an enriched functor: an object map with chain maps $\mathcal A(x,y)\to\mathcal B(Fx,Fy)$ compatible with identities and composition. A closed degree-zero $u\in\mathcal A(x,y)^0$ is invertible in $H^0$ when there are a closed degree-zero $v$ and degree $-1$ elements $a,b$ with $d(a)=vu-1_x$ and $d(b)=uv-1_y$.
